scope: Point-LIO simulation odometry transport; existing geometry/terrain/velocity settings preserved
notes: reliable_gui and reliable_gui_repeat ran with transport-identical earlier binaries while diagnostics were being built; final_gui and final_spin use the completed final build without concurrent compilation.
Missing stamps are measured by ROS observers; no packet capture was performed to identify a specific DDS fragment loss mechanism.
Baseline GUI observer used best-effort for converted clouds; configured reliable observer used reliable after the fix. All odometry observers kept identical best-effort QoS.
